# NOMINA Creative

> NOMINA Creative adalah jasa Event Organizer Jakarta (EO terdekat di Jakarta Selatan) sejak 2016 yang melayani Event Organiser, Technical Custom Production, Rental Equipment, Web Development, dan SaaS Management.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://nomina-creative.com): Full overview of NOMINA Creative, featured showreel, client roster, and core services (Event Organiser, Technical Custom Production, Rental Equipment, Web Development, SaaS Management).
- [About](https://nomina-creative.com/about): Studio background, creative legacy since 2016, leadership team, and event & production capabilities in South Jakarta.
- [Portfolio](https://nomina-creative.com/portfolio): Selected portfolio showcasing corporate celebrations, brand activations, custom stage production, and experiential events across Jakarta and Indonesia.
- [Career](https://nomina-creative.com/career): Career opportunities and current open positions (Project Manager, Production Manager, Sales and Account Manager, 3D Visualisation).
- [3D Visualisation Role](https://nomina-creative.com/career-3d-visualisation): Role overview, highlighted job summary, responsibilities, qualifications, and perks for 3D Visualisation specialists.
- [Job Application](https://nomina-creative.com/job-application): Direct candidate application and CV submission portal for Project Manager, Production Manager, Sales and Account Manager, and 3D Visualisation roles.
- [Contact](https://nomina-creative.com/contact): Interactive South Jakarta studio map, contact details, directions, and project inquiry form.
